member.name: F:ReadyM.Api.Helpers.PendingActionScheduler`1.DefaultRunSynchronouslyTimeoutMs
member.summary: Default upper bound (in milliseconds) for how long the overloads wait for the scheduler thread to execute the scheduled action. Hitting this bound means the scheduler stopped draining its queue, which would otherwise block the calling thread forever.
member.remarks: Scheduler can end up never executing a task that was added to its queue due to an exception or a different kind of bug. A finite time limit is the only way to make sure that this kind of issue, regardles of its exact cause, will always end up throwing an exception eventually instead of blocking the waiting thread forever. This is especially important for integration tests, which use different overloads extensively and when the main test thread is blocked, a test gets stuck instead of failing.

member.name: T:ReadyM.Api.Idents.CellId
member.summary: Identifies a cell within an area. has to be unique within its parent area (identified by ). The main difference between a cell and an area is that a player can be only in one area at once, but can have many cells active within that area. Cells are only used in OblivionMP for now. WukongMP does not use cells.

member.name: T:ReadyM.Api.Idents.FullCellId
member.summary: Fully identifies a cell across the whole game world by pairing it with its parent area. A only has to be unique within its parent , so a cell can only be uniquely identified by the (, ) pair represented by this struct.
member.remarks: This struct doesn't replace , because most of the time can be inferred from the context of which area is a given player in. Cells are only used in OblivionMP for now. WukongMP does not use cells.
